title: Sex Differences in Institutional Support for Junior Biomedical Researchers
notes: OK ($889k vs $350k medians) - verified from publisher press release, not the letter itself. Press release (JAMA Network): median start-up support men $889,000 vs women $350,000; 40% of men vs 12% of women reported >$1 million (219 applicants, 2012-2014).
